align.bottom.description: Aligns the selected or given layers to their bottom edge.

align.hcenter.description: Aligns the selected or given layers on their horizontal centres.

align.left.description: Aligns the selected or given layers to their left edge (or a single layer to its parent).

align.right.description: Aligns the selected or given layers to their right edge.

align.top.description: Aligns the selected or given layers to their top edge.

align.vcenter.description: Aligns the selected or given layers on their vertical centres.

annotation.add.description: Adds a developer annotation to a layer with a note, pinned properties and a category.

annotation.addCategory.description: Adds an annotation category with a name and colour; answers its id.

annotation.categories.description: Answers the annotation categories with their colours and use counts.

annotation.edit.description: Edits a layer's annotation at index: its note, pinned properties or category.

annotation.editCategory.description: Renames or recolours an annotation category.

annotation.list.description: Answers the annotations on layers or a page, optionally of one category.

annotation.remove.description: Removes one or every annotation from a layer.

annotation.removeCategory.description: Deletes an annotation category; its annotations stay uncategorised.

arrange.back.description: Sends the selected or given layers to the back of their parent.

arrange.backward.description: Sends the selected or given layers one step backward.

arrange.forward.description: Brings the selected or given layers one step forward.

arrange.front.description: Brings the selected or given layers to the front of their parent.

arrange.packH.description: Packs the selected layers side by side horizontally with no gaps.

arrange.packV.description: Packs the selected layers one above another vertically with no gaps.

arrange.reorder.description: Moves one selected layer into another's visual slot (or swaps them) without changing the hierarchy.

source.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

target.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

arrange.roundToPixels.description: Rounds the position and size of the selected or given layers to whole pixels.

arrange.spacing.description: Sets the horizontal and/or vertical spacing between the selected or given layers.

arrange.tidy.description: Tidies the selected layers into an evenly spaced grid, or by a fixed spacing.

board.connector.description: Connects two layers or page points with a straight, elbow or curved connector with caps.

board.ink.description: Draws a marker or highlighter stroke from SVG path data or points on a board.

board.label.description: Sets (or removes) a connector's label text.

board.nextSticky.description: Adds a sticky of the same colour beside another (right, below, left or above).

board.reattach.description: Moves one end of a connector to another layer or a free page point.

board.setColor.description: Sets the board colour of stickies, shapes, connectors and ink.

board.setStyle.description: Sets board styles: shape kind and font size of shapes, connector style and caps.

board.shape.description: Adds a shape with text (rectangle, ellipse, diamond, speech bubble and more) on a board.

parent.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

board.stamp.description: Places a stamp badge (thumbs up, heart, +1, star, question, check) on a board.

board.sticky.description: Adds a sticky note with text and colour on a board; answers its id.

parent.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

board.table.description: Adds a table of rows and columns (optionally filled from cells) on a board.

board.tableEdit.description: Adds or removes a row or column of a board table.

board.template.description: Places a board template's sections, stickies, shapes and connectors; answers the ids.

board.templates.description: Answers the board templates with their names, descriptions and sizes.

board.timer.description: Starts, pauses, resumes, extends or stops the board's countdown timer; answers its state.

board.timerState.description: Answers the board timer's state and time left.

board.vote.description: Runs a voting session: starts it, casts or retracts a vote, ends or clears it.

board.voteResults.description: Answers the voting session's state, your votes and, once ended, the ranked results.

bool.exclude.description: Sets exclude as the boolean operation of the selected operands or group, or wraps layers in an exclude boolean group.

bool.flatten.description: Flattens boolean groups into plain vector layers of their result.

bool.intersect.description: Sets intersect as the boolean operation of the selected operands or group, or wraps layers in an intersect boolean group.

bool.subtract.description: Sets subtract as the boolean operation of the selected operands or group, or wraps layers in a subtract boolean group.

bool.union.description: Sets union as the boolean operation of the selected operands or group, or wraps layers in a union boolean group.

codeConnect.export.description: Answers (or writes) every component's code connections as a connect JSON file.

codeConnect.import.description: Imports code connections from connect JSON, linking each entry to components of that name.

codeConnect.remove.description: Removes a component's code connection for a language (or all).

codeConnect.set.description: Connects a component to code in a language: import path, name and call template.

command.batch.description: Runs a list of commands as one undo step (later steps can refer to earlier results with as); use it for multi-step edits.

comment.add.description: Adds a comment thread at a page point, optionally pinned to a layer; answers its id.

comment.delete.description: Deletes a comment thread or one reply.

comment.edit.description: Edits the first message or a reply of a comment thread.

comment.link.description: Answers a link to a comment thread.

comment.list.description: Answers comment threads on a page or every page, filtered, sorted and searched.

comment.markRead.description: Marks a comment thread (or every thread) read or unread.

comment.move.description: Moves a comment pin to a page point, pinned to a layer or the page.

comment.next.description: Opens the next or previous comment thread in the filtered list.

comment.open.description: Opens a comment thread and zooms or centres the view on it.

comment.people.description: Answers the people taking part in the file's comments.

comment.react.description: Adds, removes or toggles an emoji reaction on a comment or reply.

comment.zoom.description: Zooms the view to fit comment threads on the current page.

component.addProperty.description: Adds a boolean, text, instance-swap, variant or slot property to a component or set, optionally binding a layer.

component.addVariant.description: Adds a variant to a component set by duplicating one, named by a property value.

component.bindProperty.description: Binds a layer's visibility, text, swapped component or slot to a component property (or unbinds it).

component.combineVariants.description: Combines main components into a component set of variants.

component.create.description: Makes the selected frame or group a component, or wraps several layers in one.

component.createMultiple.description: Makes each selected layer its own component.

component.deleteProperty.description: Deletes a component property from a component or set.

component.detach.description: Detaches the selected instances from their main component, turning them into frames.

component.editProperty.description: Edits a component property: its name, default value, variant values or preferred components.

component.exposeInstance.description: Exposes a nested instance's properties on its main component's instances (or stops).

component.goToMain.description: Selects and shows the main component of an instance.

component.hideWhenPublishing.description: Keeps components (or sets) out of the library this file publishes, or toggles that.

component.list.description: Answers the file's components with their type, page, instance count, Assets panel folder and library.

component.makeSlot.description: Makes a frame inside a main component a slot that instances can fill with any content.

component.playground.description: Answers what a component looks like and its code for given property values, without changing the design.

component.properties.description: Answers the properties of a component, set or instance with their types and values.

component.pushChanges.description: Pushes an instance's overrides into its main component, updating every instance.

component.removeSlot.description: Turns a slot frame back into an ordinary frame; instances lose their own content in it.

component.resetInstance.description: Resets every override of the selected instances back to their main component.

component.resetOverride.description: Resets one group of overrides (fills, text, size and more) or all overrides of an instance.

component.restoreMain.description: Restores a deleted main component from one of its instances, in that instance's place.

data.fill.description: Repeats a frame once per data row, filling named text layers, fills and visibility from each row.

dev.compare.description: Answers what changed in a ready-for-dev frame or section since it was marked (or since a saved version).

dev.focus.description: Shows only one top-level frame or section on the canvas (or the next or previous ready-for-dev one); answers which.

id.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

dev.resolveChange.description: Marks changed ready-for-dev frames and sections as resolved, back to Ready for dev, with a reason.

dev.unfocus.description: Leaves focus view so the whole page shows again.

devMode.addMeasurement.description: Keeps a measurement on the canvas between two layers or across one side of a layer.

from.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

to.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

devMode.measurements.description: Answers the kept measurements on a page, with their lines and labels.

devMode.removeMeasurement.description: Removes one or every kept measurement starting from a layer.

from.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

devResource.add.description: Adds a developer link (URL and name) to a layer; answers its index.

devResource.edit.description: Edits a layer's own developer link at index.

devResource.list.description: Answers a layer's developer links, its own first, then those inherited from its main component.

devResource.remove.description: Removes one or every developer link of a layer's own.

distribute.horizontal.description: Spaces the selected or given layers evenly horizontally, or by a fixed spacing.

distribute.vertical.description: Spaces the selected or given layers evenly vertically, or by a fixed spacing.

edit.copy.description: Copies the selected or given layers to the clipboard without changing the design.

edit.copyProperties.description: Copies a layer's fills, strokes, effects and text style so edit.pasteProperties can apply them.

edit.cut.description: Removes the selected or given layers and puts them on the clipboard.

edit.delete.description: Deletes the selected or given layers.

edit.duplicate.description: Duplicates the selected or given layers, offset by dx, dy (or repeating the last duplicate's offset); answers the copies.

edit.findReplace.description: Finds text in text layers (or layer names) and replaces it, selecting the matches by default; answers the count.

edit.paste.description: Pastes the clipboard into a parent (default the current page or frame) at x, y; a copied main component pastes as an instance.

parent.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

edit.pasteDesignLayers.description: Pastes layers copied from another design app (clipboard HTML or design data) into a parent at x, y.

parent.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

edit.pasteOver.description: Pastes the clipboard on top of the selection, at the same position.

edit.pasteProperties.description: Applies the copied properties (fills, strokes, effects, text style) to the selected or given layers.

edit.pasteReplace.description: Replaces the selected or given layers with the clipboard's content, in their places.

edit.pickColor.description: Picks the colour under the eyedropper and optionally applies it to the selection.

edit.redo.description: Redoes the last undone step in a scope (the person's or the agent's; default the caller's).

edit.repeat.description: Repeats the last command on the current selection.

edit.setDefaultProperties.description: Makes a layer's properties the defaults for new layers of its kind.

edit.undo.description: Undoes the last step in a scope (the person's or the agent's; default the caller's), leaving the other scope's later steps in place.

effect.add.description: Adds an effect (drop shadow, inner shadow, layer or background blur, noise, texture, glass) to the selected or given layers.

effect.copy.description: Copies one effect of a layer (default the top one) so effect.paste can apply it.

effect.move.description: Moves an effect from one index to another in the effect list of the selected or given layers.

effect.paste.description: Pastes the copied effect onto the selected or given layers, replacing the effect at index or adding one.

effect.remove.description: Removes the effect at index from the selected or given layers.

effect.set.description: Changes the effect at index on the selected or given layers.

export.add.description: Adds an export setting (size, suffix, format, PDF bleed) to the selected or given layers, used by file.exportLayers.

export.remove.description: Removes the export setting at index from the selected or given layers.

export.update.description: Edits the export setting at index on the selected or given layers: size, suffix, format and PDF options.

file.colorProfile.description: Sets the file's colour profile (sRGB or Display P3), converting colour values or reinterpreting them; without a profile answers the current one.

file.export.description: Exports layers (default the selection, else the page) as PNG, JPEG, SVG, PDF, WebP, Android Vector Drawable or the whole .fig, at a scale with print options; answers the data.

file.exportFramesPdf.description: Exports every top-level frame of a page, in reading order, as one PDF with optional bleed, marks and CMYK.

file.exportLayers.description: Exports the selected layers (or every layer with export settings) by their export settings, or their assets, as files or a zip.

file.exportSvg.description: Exports the selected or given layers as SVG markup or to a file.

file.import.description: Imports a file (SVG, image, .fig, .sketch or REST JSON) into the design at x, y; SVG becomes an editable frame of shapes and text.

file.placeImage.description: Places an image from a path or base64 data as a new image layer at x, y.

file.saveVersion.description: Opens the version history's save form: the editor saves the version with the host, which keeps saved versions (never the design or its file).

file.versionHistory.description: Opens the version history panel; the host keeps the saved versions.

fill.add.description: Adds a fill paint (default light grey, white for frames) on top of the selected or given layers' fills.

fill.copy.description: Copies one fill of a layer (default the top one) so fill.paste can apply it.

fill.move.description: Moves a fill from one index to another in the fill list of the selected or given layers (bottom first).

fill.paste.description: Pastes the copied fill onto the selected or given layers, replacing the fill at index or adding one.

fill.pattern.description: Fills the selected or given layers with a pattern of a source layer, with tiling, scale, spacing and alignment.

source.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

fill.remove.description: Removes the fill at index from the selected or given layers.

fill.set.description: Sets the fill at index (default the top one) of the selected or given layers to a paint or colour, with opacity, visibility and blend.

frame.create.description: Creates a frame from a device preset or a size, in a parent, with a name and properties; answers its id.

parent.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

frame.presets.description: Answers the device and paper frame presets with their sizes, for frame.create.

frame.swapOrientation.description: Swaps the width and height of the selected or given frames (portrait and landscape).

grid.add.description: Adds a layout grid (grid, columns or rows) to the selected or given frames.

grid.move.description: Moves a layout grid from one index to another in the selected or given frames.

grid.remove.description: Removes the layout grid at index from the selected or given frames.

guide.add.description: Adds a vertical or horizontal ruler guide at an offset on a frame or the page; answers its index.

guide.clear.description: Removes all ruler guides from a frame or the page.

guide.move.description: Moves a ruler guide to a new offset.

guide.remove.description: Removes a ruler guide (default the selected one).

guide.select.description: Selects a ruler guide so it can be deleted or nudged, deselecting layers.

image.adjust.description: Adjusts the image paints of the selected or given layers with a preset or filters (exposure, contrast, saturation, temperature and more).

image.deletePreset.description: Deletes a saved image adjustment preset from the file.

image.place.description: Places an image from base64 or a path as a new image layer, or adds it as a fill on an existing layer.

parent.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

target.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

image.presets.description: Answers the built-in and saved image adjustment presets with their filters.

image.savePreset.description: Saves an image adjustment preset in the file from filters or the first selected image paint's adjustments.

inspect.assets.description: Answers the layers in and under the selection to hand over as files: those with export settings, icons and images.

inspect.code.description: Answers code for a layer in CSS, HTML, React, Vue, Tailwind, SwiftUI, Compose and more, with unit options.

inspect.componentCode.description: Answers a component's code in a language with its properties as parameters.

inspect.properties.description: Answers a layer's inspect properties (layout, auto layout, typography, fills, strokes, effects) as sections of rows.

inspect.readyForDev.description: Answers the frames and sections marked ready for dev (or changed or completed) on a page or every page.

instance.create.description: Creates an instance of a component (or a set's default variant) at x, y in a parent; answers its id.

component.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

parent.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

instance.exposed.description: Answers the nested instances whose properties an instance exposes.

instance.place.description: Places an instance of a component centred at a page point, inside the frame under it.

component.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

instance.resetSlot.description: Resets an instance's slot back to its main component's default content.

instance.setProperties.description: Sets component property values on the selected or given instances (variant properties switch variants).

instance.slotInsert.description: Inserts an instance of a component into a slot of an instance, optionally clearing the slot first.

component.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

instance.swap.description: Swaps the selected or given instances to another component.

component.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

instance.swapAt.description: Swaps the instance at a page point to another component, as dropping from the Assets panel with Alt does.

component.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

layers.collapseAll.description: Collapses every row in the layers panel; the design is unchanged.

layout.add.description: Adds auto layout (horizontal, vertical or grid) to the selected or given frames, or wraps other layers in an auto-layout frame.

layout.remove.description: Removes auto layout from the selected or given frames, keeping their children where they are.

layout.setTrack.description: Sets the sizing (fixed, hug or fill) of one column or row track of a grid auto layout.

layout.suggest.description: Adds the auto layout that best fits the current arrangement of the selected layers.

library.acceptUpdates.description: Pulls in updated library components, styles and variables; instances keep their overrides.

library.add.description: Enables a library from a published .kdesign file or a share link so its components, styles and variables can be used.

library.aliasVariable.description: Copies a library variable in and makes a local variable an alias of it in a mode.

alias.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

library.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

mode.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

variable.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

library.applyStyle.description: Copies a published library style in (linked, read-only) and applies it to the selected or given layers.

library.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

library.bindVariable.description: Copies a published library variable in and binds it to a field of the selected or given layers.

library.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

variable.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

library.extendCollection.description: Creates a local collection that extends a library collection, following its variables with local overrides.

collection.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

library.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

library.import.description: Copies a library component into the file as a read-only main to instantiate with instance.create.

component.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

library.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

library.importVariable.description: Copies a published library variable in as a linked read-only copy for binding or aliasing.

library.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

variable.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

library.list.description: Answers the enabled libraries with versions and updates, and this file's published library, optionally with their assets.

library.place.description: Places an instance of a published library component at a page point (default the view's centre).

component.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

library.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

library.publish.description: Publishes the file's components, sets, styles and variable collections as a library (all or exactly the given ones).

library.remove.description: Disables a library; copies still in use stay.

library.setVariableMode.description: Copies a library collection in and sets one of its modes on frames or the page.

collection.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

library.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

mode.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

library.swap.description: Re-points every instance, style and variable copied from one library to the same-named ones in another.

from.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

to.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

library.swapAt.description: Copies a library component in and swaps the instance at a page point to it.

component.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

library.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

library.updates.description: Answers the library components, styles and variables that have newer published versions.

measure.distances.description: Answers the distance lines from the selection to another layer (default its parent), as Alt-hover shows.

to.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

measure.padding.description: Answers the padding and gap lines of an auto layout frame, as Shift+Alt-hover shows.

node.create.description: Creates a layer of a type (rectangle, ellipse, polygon, star, line, arrow, vector, text, frame, section, component, slice) at x, y in a parent with properties; answers its id.

parent.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

node.get.description: Answers one layer's properties by id: its type, geometry, paints, effects, layout and children.

node.reorder.description: Moves a layer to an index among its siblings.

node.reparent.description: Moves layers into another parent at an index among its children.

parent.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

node.set.description: Sets properties of a layer: name, visibility, lock, opacity, blend, position, size, rotation, fills, strokes, effects, corner radius, constraints, auto layout and text fields.

object.batchRename.description: Renames several layers at once by find and replace (optionally regex) or a pattern with numbering codes.

object.convertToFrame.description: Converts the selected or given groups or sections into frames of the same box in place.

object.convertToGroup.description: Converts the selected or given frames into groups in place, dropping frame-only properties like auto layout and fills.

object.convertToSection.description: Converts the selected or given top-level frames into sections in place, keeping their fill and layers.

object.flipH.description: Flips the selected or given layers (or selected vector points) horizontally.

object.flipV.description: Flips the selected or given layers (or selected vector points) vertically.

object.frameSelection.description: Wraps the selected or given layers in a new frame, optionally named.

object.group.description: Groups the selected or given layers, optionally naming the group.

object.hideOthers.description: Hides every layer on the page except the selected ones.

object.mask.description: Uses the bottom selected layer as a mask for the layers above it in a group.

object.moveToPage.description: Moves the selected or given layers to another page.

object.opacityKeys.description: Sets the selection's opacity from typed digits, as the number keys do (1 is 10%, 0 is 100%, two digits a percentage).

object.rasterize.description: Replaces the selected or given layers with an image of them at a scale (default 2).

object.releaseMask.description: Releases a mask so the layers above it are no longer clipped.

object.removeFill.description: Removes every fill from the selected or given layers.

object.removeFrame.description: Removes the selected frames, keeping their children in place.

object.removeStroke.description: Removes every stroke from the selected or given layers.

object.rename.description: Renames the selected or given layers (without a name, starts inline renaming in the layers panel).

object.resizeToFit.description: Resizes frames, sections and components to fit their contents without moving the contents.

object.rotate180.description: Rotates the selected or given layers (or selected vector points) by 180 degrees.

object.rotateLeft.description: Rotates the selected or given layers (or selected vector points) 90 degrees counter-clockwise.

object.rotateRight.description: Rotates the selected or given layers (or selected vector points) 90 degrees clockwise.

object.setThumbnail.description: Sets a frame as the file's thumbnail.

object.swapFillStroke.description: Swaps the fills and strokes of the selected or given layers.

object.toggleLock.description: Locks, unlocks or toggles the lock of the selected or given layers.

object.toggleVisible.description: Shows, hides or toggles the visibility of the selected or given layers.

object.ungroup.description: Ungroups the selected or given groups, keeping their children in place.

object.wrapInSection.description: Wraps the selected or given top-level layers in a new section with some room around them.

page.add.description: Adds a page (a name starting with a hyphen adds a divider).

page.delete.description: Deletes a page (default the current one) with its layers.

page.duplicate.description: Duplicates a page (default the current one) with its layers.

page.list.description: Answers the file's pages with their ids, names and which is current.

page.move.description: Moves a page to an index in the page list.

page.rename.description: Renames a page (default the current one).

page.select.description: Switches to a page by id or index.

page.setBackground.description: Sets a page's canvas background colour.

paint.documentColors.description: Answers the solid colours used on a page, most used first.

pref.highlightHover.description: Sets whether layers highlight on hover.

pref.keepTool.description: Sets whether a drawing tool stays selected after use.

pref.nudge.description: Sets the small and big nudge amounts used by transform.nudge.

pref.numberKeysOpacity.description: Sets whether number keys set the selection's opacity.

pref.renameDuplicates.description: Sets whether duplicated layers get numbered names.

pref.showDimensions.description: Sets whether the canvas shows dimensions on selected objects.

proto.action.add.description: Adds an action to a prototype interaction, at a path inside conditionals.

proto.action.move.description: Moves a prototype action to another index in the same list.

proto.action.remove.description: Removes the prototype action at a path (an interaction keeps at least one).

proto.action.set.description: Replaces the prototype action at a path in an interaction.

proto.conditional.addBlock.description: Adds an else-if (with a condition) or else block to a conditional prototype action.

proto.conditional.removeBlock.description: Removes a block of a conditional prototype action.

proto.conditional.setCondition.description: Edits the condition of a block of a conditional prototype action.

proto.evaluate.description: Evaluates a prototype expression (variables, modes, arithmetic) on a layer and answers its value.

proto.flow.add.description: Adds a prototype flow starting at a top-level frame (default the selection).

proto.flow.remove.description: Removes a prototype flow starting point.

proto.flow.rename.description: Renames a prototype flow and sets its description.

proto.interaction.add.description: Adds a prototype interaction to a layer: a trigger (click, hover, drag, key, delay and more), actions and a transition.

proto.interaction.clear.description: Removes every prototype interaction from the selected or given layers.

proto.interaction.remove.description: Removes the prototype interaction at index from a layer.

proto.interaction.set.description: Replaces or patches the prototype interaction at index: trigger, actions, transition, duration, easing and delay.

proto.linkNotice.description: Sets whether a presented prototype warns before opening a website link.

proto.present.description: Opens the prototype presenter from a frame (default the selected frame or first flow).

proto.presentOptions.description: Sets how the presenter sizes the prototype and whether it shows the device frame, hotspot hints and inspect.

proto.preview.description: Opens a floating live prototype preview over the canvas from a frame.

proto.settings.description: Sets the prototype's device, background, rotation, device colour and custom size.

section.toggleContents.description: Hides or shows the contents of the selected or given sections (a hidden section shows only its name and outline).

select.add.description: Adds the layers ids to the selection.

select.all.description: Selects every layer on the current page (or in the current frame).

select.area.description: Selects the layers inside a marquee rectangle (adding or including nested layers as asked); answers the selection.

select.byName.description: Selects the layers whose names match a query on the current page or every page.

select.children.description: Selects the children of the selected layers.

select.inverse.description: Selects the layers that aren't selected and deselects the others.

select.layersAt.description: Answers every layer under a page point, front-most first, with its id, name, type and depth.

select.matching.description: Selects the layers that match the selected one in kind and properties.

select.next.description: Selects the next sibling of the selected layer.

select.none.description: Clears the selection, deselecting every layer.

select.parent.description: Selects the parent of the selected layers.

select.previous.description: Selects the previous sibling of the selected layer.

select.remove.description: Removes the layers ids from the selection.

select.sameEffect.description: Selects every layer with the same effects as the selected layer.

select.sameFill.description: Selects every layer with the same fill as the selected layer.

select.sameFont.description: Selects every text layer using the same font as the selected one.

select.sameInstance.description: Selects every instance of the same component as the selected instance.

select.sameProperties.description: Selects every layer with the same properties as the selected layer.

select.sameStroke.description: Selects every layer with the same stroke as the selected layer.

select.sameText.description: Selects every text layer with the same text properties as the selected one.

select.set.description: Replaces the selection with the layers ids.

selection.applyColorStyle.description: Applies a colour style to the given fill or stroke slots (from selection.colors).

selection.bindColorVariable.description: Binds a colour variable to the given solid fill or stroke slots (from selection.colors).

variable.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

selection.colors.description: Answers the colours used by the selection (descendants and text ranges included) with the paint slots that use each.

selection.detachColor.description: Unlinks the colour style or variable of the given paint slots, keeping their colour values.

selection.selectColor.description: Selects the layers that own the given paint slots; answers their ids.

selection.setPaint.description: Replaces the paint in given fill or stroke slots (from selection.colors) with a new paint.

shape.arrow.description: Draws an arrow of a length from x, y in a parent, with optional properties; answers its id.

parent.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

shape.ellipse.description: Draws an ellipse in the box x, y, width, height in a parent, with optional properties; answers its id.

parent.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

shape.line.description: Draws a line of a length from x, y (optionally rotated) in a parent; answers its id.

parent.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

shape.polygon.description: Draws a polygon in a box with a point count in a parent; answers its id.

parent.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

shape.rectangle.description: Draws a rectangle at x, y with width and height in a parent, with optional properties; answers its id.

parent.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

shape.star.description: Draws a star in a box with a point count and inner radius in a parent; answers its id.

parent.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

shapeBuilder.merge.description: Merges shape builder regions (by index or page points) into one new shape styled like the top-most paint over them.

shapeBuilder.mode.description: Sets what a shape builder click does: merge or remove.

shapeBuilder.regions.description: Answers the regions the shape builder sees among the selected or given layers, with their paths, sources and covering paints.

shapeBuilder.remove.description: Removes shape builder regions (by index or page points) from the shapes and strokes covering them.

stroke.add.description: Adds a stroke paint (default black) to the selected or given layers.

stroke.brush.description: Applies a stretched or scattered brush preset to the selected strokes, with spacing and jitter, or clears it.

stroke.copy.description: Copies one stroke of a layer with its weight, alignment, caps, joins and dashes so stroke.paste can apply it.

stroke.move.description: Moves a stroke from one index to another in the stroke list of the selected or given layers.

stroke.paste.description: Pastes the copied stroke with its settings onto the selected or given layers, replacing or adding one.

stroke.remove.description: Removes the stroke at index from the selected or given layers.

stroke.set.description: Sets the stroke at index of the selected or given layers to a paint or colour, with opacity, visibility and blend.

stroke.widthProfile.description: Sets a variable width profile (a preset or points of scale along the path) on the selected strokes.

style.apply.description: Applies a style by id or name to the selected or given layers (fill or stroke for paint styles, a range for text styles).

style.bind.description: Binds a variable to a field of a style's value (or unbinds it).

variable.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

style.create.description: Creates a paint, text, effect or grid style from a layer (default the first selected) or a value; answers its id.

from.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

style.delete.description: Deletes a style; layers using it keep their values.

style.detach.description: Detaches a style from the selected or given layers' fills, strokes, effects, grids or text, keeping their values.

style.duplicate.description: Duplicates a style right below it; answers the new id.

style.list.description: Answers the file's styles, optionally of one type, with their ids, names and values.

style.move.description: Moves styles before another style or into a folder.

before.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

style.renameFolder.description: Renames a style folder, renaming the styles in it.

style.update.description: Edits a style's name, description or value, or redefines it from a layer.

from.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

text.alignCenter.description: Centres the text of the selected or given text layers.

text.alignJustify.description: Justifies the text of the selected or given text layers.

text.alignLeft.description: Aligns the text of the selected or given text layers to the left.

text.alignRight.description: Aligns the text of the selected or given text layers to the right.

text.bold.description: Toggles bold on the selected or given text layers (or the selected text range).

text.bulletList.description: Turns the selected or given text's paragraphs into a bulleted list (or back to plain text).

text.case.description: Sets the letter case display (original, upper, lower, title, small caps) of the selected or given text.

text.caseLower.description: Displays the selected or given text in lowercase.

text.caseOriginal.description: Sets the selected or given text back to its original case (no case transform).

text.caseSmallCaps.description: Displays the selected or given text in small caps.

text.caseTitle.description: Displays the selected or given text in title case.

text.caseUpper.description: Displays the selected or given text in uppercase.

text.create.description: Creates a text layer at x, y in a parent with optional fixed width and text properties (font, size and more); answers its id.

parent.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

text.decoration.description: Sets the text decoration (none, underline, strikethrough) of the selected or given text.

text.edit.begin.description: Starts editing a text layer with the caret at a character index (default all selected).

text.edit.caret.description: Moves the caret of the text being edited to a character index, optionally extending the selection.

text.edit.end.description: Stops editing text and commits what was typed, leaving the text layer selected.

text.edit.insert.description: Types text at the caret of the text being edited, replacing the selected range.

text.edit.key.description: Presses an editing key (backspace, arrows, home, end, enter, tab and more) in the text being edited.

text.edit.preedit.description: Shows IME composition text at the caret (empty cancels); text.edit.insert commits it.

text.edit.selectLine.description: Selects the line at a character index in the text being edited.

text.edit.selectWord.description: Selects the word at a character index in the text being edited.

text.edit.selection.description: Answers the caret and selected range of the text being edited.

text.endPreview.description: Ends a text preview, putting the document back as it was.

text.fit.description: Shrinks the font of text layers so their text fits the box, within a minimum size and line limit.

text.fonts.description: Answers the available font families, or one family's styles with their OpenType features and variation axes.

text.italic.description: Toggles italic on the selected or given text layers (or the selected text range).

text.lineHeightDown.description: Decreases the line height of the selected or given text layers by one step.

text.lineHeightUp.description: Increases the line height of the selected or given text layers by one step.

text.link.description: Makes the selected or given text (or text range) a hyperlink to url.

text.listIndent.description: Nests the selected list items one level deeper while editing text.

text.listOutdent.description: Moves the selected list items one level out while editing text.

text.listStyle.description: Sets the list style (none, bulleted, numbered) of the selected or given text's paragraphs.

text.maxLines.description: Limits the selected or given text to a number of lines, truncating the rest (0 for no limit).

text.missingFonts.description: Answers the font families the document uses that aren't installed, with the layers that use them.

text.numberList.description: Turns the selected or given text's paragraphs into a numbered list (or back to plain text).

text.onPath.description: Puts a text layer on a vector or shape path, starting at a fraction along it, optionally flipped.

text.paragraphIndent.description: Sets the paragraph indent in pixels of the selected or given text.

text.paragraphSpacing.description: Sets the spacing between paragraphs in pixels of the selected or given text.

text.pathOptions.description: Sets where text on a path starts and whether it is flipped.

text.preview.description: Previews what a text style or font command would do on the canvas without an undo step; text.endPreview restores.

text.refit.description: Measures auto-sizing text boxes again in their current fonts (for example after a missing font arrived); answers the layers refitted.

text.removeFromPath.description: Takes text off its path, back to a line of auto-width text.

text.set.description: Replaces the characters of a text layer (default the selected one).

text.setFeatures.description: Turns OpenType features on or off (or back to the font default) on the selected or given text.

text.setVariations.description: Sets variable-font axis values (or back to the style default) on the selected or given text.

text.sizeDown.description: Decreases the font size of the selected or given text layers by one step.

text.sizeUp.description: Increases the font size of the selected or given text layers by one step.

text.strikethrough.description: Toggles strikethrough on the selected or given text layers (or the selected text range).

text.style.description: Styles a character range of a text layer: font family, style, weight, size, line height, letter spacing, decoration, case, link and fills.

text.trackingDown.description: Decreases the letter spacing of the selected or given text layers by one step.

text.trackingUp.description: Increases the letter spacing of the selected or given text layers by one step.

text.underline.description: Toggles underline on the selected or given text layers (or the selected text range).

text.weightDown.description: Moves the selected or given text to the next lighter font weight available.

text.weightUp.description: Moves the selected or given text to the next heavier font weight available.

tool.arrow.description: Chooses the Arrow tool in the editor; use shape.arrow to draw one directly.

tool.comment.description: Chooses the Comment tool in the editor; use comment.add to add a comment directly.

tool.connector.description: Chooses the connector tool; use board.connector to connect directly.

tool.ellipse.description: Chooses the Ellipse tool in the editor; use shape.ellipse to draw one directly.

tool.eraser.description: Chooses the board eraser that removes marker and highlighter strokes.

tool.frame.description: Chooses the Frame tool in the editor; use frame.create to make a frame directly.

tool.hand.description: Chooses the Hand tool in the editor; the design is unchanged.

tool.highlighter.description: Chooses the highlighter tool; use board.ink with highlighter to draw directly.

tool.line.description: Chooses the Line tool in the editor; use shape.line to draw one directly.

tool.marker.description: Chooses the marker tool; use board.ink to draw directly.

tool.move.description: Chooses the Move tool in the editor; the design is unchanged.

tool.pen.description: Chooses the Pen tool in the editor; use vector.create to make a path directly.

tool.pencil.description: Chooses the Pencil tool in the editor; use vector.create to make a path directly.

tool.pencilBrush.description: Sets (or answers) the brush new Pencil strokes get: a preset with spacing and jitter.

tool.place.description: Places what a click with a shape or frame tool makes at x, y (default the middle of the view), selected.

tool.polygon.description: Chooses the Polygon tool in the editor; use shape.polygon to draw one directly.

tool.rectangle.description: Chooses the Rectangle tool in the editor; use shape.rectangle to draw one directly.

tool.scale.description: Chooses the Scale tool in the editor; the design is unchanged.

tool.scaleAnchor.description: Sets (or answers) the point that stays put when the Scale tool scales.

tool.section.description: Chooses the Section tool in the editor; use node.create to make a section directly.

tool.set.description: Chooses an editor tool by name; the design is unchanged. Prefer the shape and node commands to create layers directly.

tool.shape.description: Chooses the board shape tool; use board.shape to add one directly.

tool.shapeBuilder.description: Chooses the Shape builder tool in the editor; the design is unchanged.

tool.slice.description: Chooses the Slice tool in the editor; use node.create to make a slice directly.

tool.stamp.description: Chooses the stamp tool; use board.stamp to place one directly.

tool.star.description: Chooses the Star tool in the editor; use shape.star to draw one directly.

tool.sticky.description: Chooses the sticky note tool; use board.sticky to add one directly.

tool.text.description: Chooses the Text tool in the editor; use text.create to add text directly.

tool.textOnPath.description: Chooses the text-on-path tool: a click on a path puts new text on it.

transform.move.description: Moves the selected or given layers by dx, dy page units.

transform.moveTo.description: Moves the selected or given layers so their top-left is at page coordinates x, y.

transform.nudge.description: Nudges the selection by dx, dy times the nudge amount (auto-layout children move one place in the flow instead).

transform.nudgeSize.description: Grows or shrinks the selection by dw, dh times the nudge amount, top-left fixed.

transform.resize.description: Resizes the selected or given layers to a width and/or height, keeping an anchor point fixed.

transform.rotate.description: Rotates the selected or given layers by degrees about a pivot (default the rotation origin or centre).

transform.rotationOrigin.description: Shows, hides or toggles the draggable rotation origin of the selection; not saved.

transform.scale.description: Scales the selected or given layers by a factor about a pivot, scaling strokes, effects and text too (as the Scale tool does).

transform.setRotationOrigin.description: Sets the point the selection rotates about (or resets it to the centre) while the selection lasts.

variable.addMode.description: Adds a mode to a variable collection, optionally duplicating another mode's values.

collection.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

from.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

variable.bind.description: Binds a variable to a field of the selected or given layers (a paint colour, effect value, layout size, text property) or unbinds it.

variable.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

variable.create.description: Creates a colour, number, string or boolean variable in a collection with values per mode; answers its id.

collection.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

variable.createCollection.description: Creates a variable collection with mode names; answers its id.

variable.delete.description: Deletes a variable; bound layers keep their values.

variable.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

variable.deleteCollection.description: Deletes a variable collection with its variables; bound layers keep their values.

collection.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

variable.duplicate.description: Duplicates a variable; answers the new id.

variable.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

variable.export.description: Exports variable collections as the local variables JSON (for variable.import) or as CSS custom properties.

variable.import.description: Imports variable collections and variables from local variables JSON (an object, text or a path).

variable.list.description: Answers the file's variable collections, modes and variables with their values.

variable.moveMode.description: Moves a mode to an index in its collection (index 0 is the default mode).

collection.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

mode.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

variable.removeMode.description: Deletes a mode from a variable collection (a collection keeps at least one).

collection.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

mode.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

collection.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

variable.renameMode.description: Renames a mode of a variable collection.

collection.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

mode.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

variable.resetOverride.description: Resets an extended collection's overridden variable so it follows the inherited value again.

mode.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

variable.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

variable.set.description: Sets a variable's value (or an alias to another variable) in a mode.

mode.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

variable.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

variable.setMode.description: Sets which mode of a collection frames or the page use (null for the inherited mode).

collection.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

variable.update.description: Edits a variable's name, description, scopes and whether it is hidden from publishing.

variable.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

vector.create.description: Creates a vector layer from SVG path data or points, open or closed, scaled to a box, in a parent; answers its id.

parent.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

vector.deleteHeal.description: Deletes the selected vector points and heals the path across the gap.

vector.edit.addVertex.description: Adds a point on a segment at parameter t.

vector.edit.begin.description: Enters vector edit mode on layers (default the selection), converting shapes to vectors.

vector.edit.bend.description: Bends a segment so its curve passes through a page point at parameter t.

vector.edit.bounds.description: Answers the bounds of the selected points in the parent's coordinates and on the page.

vector.edit.connect.description: Connects two points with a straight segment.

vector.edit.cornerRadius.description: Sets the corner radius of points.

vector.edit.cut.description: Cuts paths at a segment point or vertex, or along a line between two page points.

vector.edit.delete.description: Deletes points and segments (default the selection) of the edited vectors.

vector.edit.erase.description: Erases the parts of paths a brush of radius passes over along page points.

vector.edit.lasso.description: Selects the points inside a lasso of page points.

vector.edit.mirroring.description: Sets handle mirroring (none, angle, angle and length) of points.

vector.edit.moveHandles.description: Moves the selected (or given) handles by dx, dy page units.

vector.edit.moveVertices.description: Moves points of the edited vectors by dx, dy local units (default the selected points).

vector.edit.nudge.description: Nudges the selected points by dx, dy page units.

vector.edit.paint.description: Fills or unfills the closed areas under page points, as the paint bucket does.

vector.edit.pen.description: Adds a pen point at a page point (with a handle drag), continuing from the pen's open end.

vector.edit.position.description: Moves the selected points so their top-left is at x, y in the parent's coordinates.

vector.edit.resize.description: Scales the selected points' box to a width and height, about its centre or top-left.

vector.edit.rotate.description: Rotates the selected points by an angle about a page pivot (default their box centre).

vector.edit.select.description: Selects points, segments, handles or regions in vector edit mode.

vector.edit.selectAll.description: Selects every point of the edited vector layers.

vector.edit.setHandle.description: Places one handle of a segment at local x, y, optionally breaking its mirroring.

vector.edit.state.description: Answers the vector edit overlay and the edited layer's vector network: points, segments, handles and regions.

vector.edit.strokeCap.description: Sets the stroke cap (round, square, arrows and more) where the stroke ends at points.

vector.edit.strokeJoin.description: Sets how the stroke turns (miter, bevel, round) at points.

vector.edit.tool.description: Chooses the tool used in vector edit mode (move, pen, bend, paint, lasso, cut, eraser, width).

vector.edit.transform.description: Transforms points (default the selected ones) by a page-space affine matrix.

vector.edit.widthPoint.description: Adds, moves, resizes or removes a variable-width point on the edited path's stroke.

vector.fillRule.description: Sets the fill rule (non-zero or even-odd) of a vector layer or one of its filled regions.

vector.flatten.description: Flattens the selected or given layers into a single vector layer.

vector.join.description: Joins the selected vector layers' open paths (or the selected points in vector edit mode).

vector.offset.description: Offsets the paths of the selected or given vector layers outward (or inward for negative offset).

vector.outlineStroke.description: Converts the strokes of the selected or given layers into filled outlines.

vector.reverse.description: Reverses the path direction of the selected or given vector layers.

vector.reverseLoop.description: Reverses the direction of one loop of a vector's filled region, which changes how the area fills.

vector.simplify.description: Reduces the points of the selected or given vector layers within a tolerance.

vector.smoothJoin.description: Joins the selected open paths or points with a smooth curve.

version.exitPreview.description: Ends a version preview and shows the current document again.

version.preview.description: Shows the design as it was at a saved version (its replica version) on the canvas read-only in place of the document; version.exitPreview goes back.

version.restore.description: Gives the design the content it had at a saved version (its replica version, as the host's checkpoint names it) as one undoable edit; the file name, what it published and the comments stay.

view.comments.description: Shows, hides or toggles comment pins; view state only.

view.devMode.description: Switches the editor into or out of Dev Mode; the design is unchanged.

view.frameOutlines.description: Shows, hides or toggles frame outlines; view state only.

view.layoutGrids.description: Shows, hides or toggles frames' layout grids; view state only.

view.maskOutlines.description: Shows, hides or toggles mask outlines; view state only.

view.nextFrame.description: Zooms the view to the next top-level frame.

view.nextPage.description: Switches to the next page of the file.

view.outlines.description: Turns outline mode on, off or toggles it; view state only.

view.outlinesHiddenLayers.description: Sets whether outline mode also outlines hidden layers.

view.outlinesObjectBounds.description: Sets whether outline mode also draws each layer's bounding box.

view.outlinesSelection.description: Turns outline mode for the selected layers only on, off or toggles it.

view.pixelGrid.description: Shows, hides or toggles the pixel grid; view state only.

view.pixelPreview.description: Turns pixel preview on, off or toggles it, at 1× or 2× rendered pixels.

view.prevFrame.description: Zooms the view to the previous top-level frame.

view.prevPage.description: Switches to the previous page of the file.

view.proofSrgb.description: Turns sRGB soft-proofing of a Display P3 file on, off or toggles it.

view.rulers.description: Shows, hides or toggles the rulers; view state only.

view.slices.description: Shows, hides or toggles slices; view state only.

view.snapGeometry.description: Turns snapping to geometry on, off or toggles it.

view.snapObjects.description: Turns snapping to objects on, off or toggles it.

view.snapPixel.description: Turns snapping to the pixel grid on, off or toggles it.

widget.click.description: Clicks a target of a widget so its plugin redraws it.

target.description: an id (a number, or its digits as text)

widget.insert.description: Inserts a widget drawn by a widget plugin at x, y; answers its state and output.

widget.list.description: Answers the widgets in the file with their plugin, state, targets, fields and menu.

widget.menu.description: Picks an item (toggle or colour) from a widget's property menu.

widget.setText.description: Types a value into an editable field of a widget.
